name: Regular City Council Meeting
agenda_text:
Regular City Council Meeting
CONSOLIDATED AGENDA
June 26, 2012
05:30 P.M.
CALL TO ORDER - City Council Chambers, 200 Civic Center Drive, Vista, California
ROLL CALL
PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE AND INVOCATION - Reverend Brian Anderson, Center for Spiritual Living
BROWN ACT NOTICE OF SIMULTANEOUS MEETING COMPENSATION
APPROVAL OF AGENDA
CLOSED SESSION
CS.
Reports on action taken in Closed Session
PRESENTATIONS
P1.
Proclamation declaring Wednesday, June 27, 2012, "Woman’s Club of Vista Day" in the City of Vista.
P2.
Proclamation declaring Thursday, June 28, 2012, "Viper Cheer Squad Day" in the City of Vista.
P3.
Proclamation declaring July 2012, "Parks Make Life Better Month" in the City of Vista.
P4.
Certificates to the Annual Appointments to Commissions and Committees, and Certificates to Outgoing Commission, Committee, and Board members.
CONSENT CALENDAR
C1.
Check Register (CC)
C2.
Approval of Minutes (CC/CDC/SA/BSD)
C3.
All Mail Ballot Process to Resolve a Tie Vote for the November 6, 2012, General Municipal Election (CC)
C4.
Unscheduled Vacancy on the Parks & Recreation Commission (CC)
C5.
Application for Cabaret License - El Asadero Restaurant, 1717 E. Vista Way (CC)
C6.
Sewer Program Management and Engineering Services Agreement with Dudek and Associates, Inc. (CC/BSD)
1.
City Council Resolution No. 2012- , approving an agreement for sewer program management and engineering services;
2.
City Council Resolution No. 2012- , approving an agreement with Buena Sanitation District for reimbursement of sewer program management and as-needed engineering services; and
3.
Buena Sanitation District Resolution No. 2012- , approving an agreement with the Chartered City of Vista for reimbursement of sewer program management and as-needed engineering services.
C7.
Statutory Election to Receive Future Property Tax Increment Payments (CC)
DISCUSSION
D1.
Five-Year Capital Improvement Program and Capital Project Budget for FY 2012/13 (CC/SA/BSD)
1.
Adopt the following, approving the Five-Year Capital Improvement Program and FY 2012/13 Capital Project Budget, and authorizing the Capital Project Budget appropriation requests for FY 2012/13: (Recommended Action continued on following page)
(Recommended Action continued from previous page)
a.
City Council Resolution No. 2012- ;
b.
Successor Agency of the Community Development Commission Resolution No. 2012- ; and
c.
Buena Sanitation District Resolution No. 2012- .
2.
Adopt City Council Resolution No. 2012- , amending the Capital Improvement Budget for FY 2011/12, approving the allocation of FY 2011/12 interest earnings to individual capital project budgets as required by the Proposition-A Ordinance, and approving adjustments to reported TransNet cash balances between authorized SANDAG projects on the FY 2011/12 TransNet Schedule-A.
D2.
CIP No. 8164 Gravity Main Ductile Iron Pipe Rehabilitation - Award of Contract (CC)
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS
REMARKS
R1.
Reports from members of the governing bodies on outside committee meetings.
R2.
Reports and comments from City officials and members of the governing bodies.
ADJOURNMENT
